pages.text: 早上醒来，咘咘发现外面的天灰灰的，风好大好大，树都在摇来摇去。
pages.text_en: When Bubu woke up, the sky was gray and the wind was blowing hard. The trees were swaying back and forth.

pages.text: 妈妈说："今天不能出去玩哦，台风要来了。"咘咘歪着头问："台风是什么呀？"
pages.text_en: Mama said, "We can't go outside today. A typhoon is coming." Bubu tilted her head and asked, "What's a typhoon?"

pages.text: NOMI拿出一本图画书，翻到一页彩色的大漩涡："台风呀，就像天空打了一个大大的喷嚏！风呼呼呼地转圈圈！"
pages.text_en: NOMI opened a picture book to a colorful swirl. "A typhoon is like the sky sneezing really hard! The wind goes whoooosh in big circles!"

pages.text: Coco从门口探进头来："Typhoon! 台风来了好exciting！我们可以play inside！"
pages.text_en: Coco popped her head in from the door. "Typhoon! How exciting! We can play inside!"

pages.text: NONO飞到窗边往外看，外面的树被吹得东倒西歪。"叽叽！风好大！我都飞不动了！"NONO缩缩脖子。
pages.text_en: NONO flew to the window and peeked outside. The trees were bending sideways. "Chirp chirp! The wind is so strong! I can't even fly!" NONO tucked in his neck.

pages.text: 咘咘和Coco趴在窗边看雨。雨点像小珠子一样噼里啪啦打在玻璃上，溅出一朵朵小水花。
pages.text_en: Bubu and Coco pressed their faces against the window watching the rain. Raindrops splattered on the glass like tiny beads, making little splashes.

pages.text: 奶奶在厨房准备零食和蜡烛。"万一停电了，我们就点蜡烛！"奶奶笑着说。
pages.text_en: Grandma was preparing snacks and candles in the kitchen. "If the power goes out, we'll light candles!" she said with a smile.

pages.text: 突然——"啪"！灯灭了！屋子里一下子暗暗的。咘咘有点害怕，紧紧抱住了NOMI。
pages.text_en: Suddenly - POP! The lights went out! The room turned dark. Bubu was a little scared and hugged NOMI tightly.

pages.text: 奶奶点起了蜡烛，暖暖的烛光照亮了大家的脸。Coco拍拍手说："Look! Like camping！像露营一样！"
pages.text_en: Grandma lit the candles, and warm candlelight glowed on everyone's faces. Coco clapped her hands: "Look! Like camping!"

pages.text: 大家在烛光下玩影子游戏！咘咘用手做出一只兔子，Coco做了一只butterfly，NOMI做了一只恐龙！影子在墙上跳来跳去。
pages.text_en: Everyone played shadow puppets by candlelight! Bubu made a bunny, Coco made a butterfly, and NOMI made a dinosaur! The shadows danced on the wall.

pages.text: 风慢慢小了，雨也慢慢停了。咘咘问："台风走了吗？"NOMI轻轻说："它去别的地方旅行了。"
pages.text_en: The wind slowly died down, and the rain gradually stopped. Bubu asked, "Is the typhoon gone?" NOMI said softly, "It went traveling somewhere else."

pages.text: 第二天早上，阳光出来了！咘咘跑到窗边——外面有落叶、有水坑、还有一道美丽的彩虹！
pages.text_en: The next morning, the sun came out! Bubu ran to the window - there were fallen leaves, puddles, and a beautiful rainbow!

pages.text: 咘咘对NOMI说："台风有点吓人，但是有你们在，一点都不怕！"NOMI笑着抱住咘咘："我们永远在一起。"
pages.text_en: Bubu said to NOMI, "The typhoon was a little scary, but with you all here, I'm not afraid at all!" NOMI hugged Bubu and smiled, "We'll always be together."
